title: TS-MAMP: A Remanufactured Agricultural Robot with Second-Life EV Components and NMS-Free On-Device Weed Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.02270v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Agriculture 4.0 robotic systems improve field efficiency yet remain too capital-intensive for the fragmented smallholdings that dominate global agriculture. Meanwhile, a growing number of retired low-speed electric-vehicle (LSEV) powertrains retain functional electromechanical value but are destructively recycled. This paper presents TS-MAMP (Telescopic-Sleeve Modular Agricultural Mobile Platform), a remanufactured robot built under 3R (reduce, reuse, recycle) circular-economy principles. Retired 48 V brushless-DC (BLDC) hub motors are paired via back-EMF matching, and lead-acid battery modules screened at 60%-80% state of health are actively balanced within a 100 mV inter-module voltage deviation. Together, these reused components reduce the powertrain-and-chassis BOM cost by approximately 60%, to below USD 450 (perception and weeding modules excluded). translated_title: TS-MAMP：一款采用退役电动汽车零部件再制造、具备无NMS端侧杂草检测的农业机器人
translated_abstract: 摘要：农业4.0机器人系统提高了田间作业效率，但对于主导全球农业的碎片化小农户而言，其资本投入仍然过高。与此同时，越来越多的退役低速电动汽车（LSEV）动力总成仍保留功能性机电价值，却被破坏性回收处理。本文提出了TS-MAMP（伸缩套筒模块化农业移动平台），这是一款基于3R（减量化、再利用、再循环）循环经济原则建造的再制造机器人。退役的48V无刷直流（BLDC）轮毂电机通过反电动势匹配进行配对，筛选出的健康状态（SOH）为60%-80%的铅酸电池模块在100mV模块间电压偏差范围内实现主动均衡。这些再利用组件共同将动力总成与底盘的物料清单（BOM）成本降低约60%，降至450美元以下（不含感知和除草模块）。桁架式底盘可提供至少200公斤的静态载荷，并可连续调节……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出TS-MAMP，一款利用退役电动汽车轮毂电机与梯次利用电池再制造的低成本模块化农业机器人，通过无NMS的端侧杂草检测技术，将动力总成与底盘成本降低约60%至450美元以下，使小农户也能负担得起农业4.0机器人技术。
en_tdlr: TS-MAMP is a remanufactured agricultural robot built from second-life EV hub motors and repurposed battery modules that cuts powertrain-and-chassis costs by approximately 60% to under USD 450, making Agriculture 4.0 robotics affordable for smallholders through NMS-free on-device weed detection.
